keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Real Salt Lake 1, LA Galaxy 0. Sergi Solans (Real Salt Lake) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Noel Caliskan with a through ball.
Goal! Real Salt Lake 2, LA Galaxy 0. Zach Booth (Real Salt Lake) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Delay in match (Real Salt Lake).
Kobi Henry (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Own Goal by Luc De Fougerolles, Real Salt Lake. Real Salt Lake 2, LA Galaxy 1.
Juan Manuel Sanabria (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Real Salt Lake 2, LA Galaxy 1.
Luc De Fougerolles (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. DeAndre Yedlin replaces Zach Booth.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Justen Glad replaces Kobi Henry.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Erik Thommy replaces Pablo Ruiz.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Robert Taylor replaces Hirving Lozano.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Ariath Piol replaces Morgan Guilavogui.
Sergi Solans (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (LA Galaxy).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Kyogo Furuhashi replaces Harbor Tarczynski-Miller.
Substitution, LA Galaxy. Calegari replaces Sergi Roberto.
Emiro Garcés (LA Galaxy) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Alexandros Katranis replaces Saba Lobjanidze.
Second Half ends, Real Salt Lake 2, LA Galaxy 1.
